description: Implementation of the Scheduler class managing task execution, dependencies, and thread synchronization in a build system.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Manages task scheduling, dependencies, and thread synchronization for build operations.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the scheduler run loop, manages task execution, and handles shutdown.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Posts a log message to be output on the main thread.

methods.name: FailWithError
methods.description: Handles error state, marks scheduler as failed, and posts error handling task.

methods.name: ScheduleWork
methods.description: Schedules a unit of work to be executed asynchronously.

methods.name: AddGenDependency
methods.description: Adds a file dependency to the scheduler.

methods.name: GetGenDependencies
methods.description: Returns the list of generated dependencies.

methods.name: AddWrittenFile
methods.description: Records a file that has been written.

methods.name: AddUnknownGeneratedInput
methods.description: Records an input file with an associated target that is unknown.

methods.name: AddWriteRuntimeDepsTarget
methods.description: Adds a target to the list of runtime dependency targets.

methods.name: GetWriteRuntimeDepsTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of targets for runtime dependencies.

methods.name: IsFileGeneratedByWriteRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if a file was generated by a runtime dependency target.

methods.name: AddGeneratedFile
methods.description: Marks a file as generated.

methods.name: IsFileGeneratedByTarget
methods.description: Checks if a file was generated by a specific target.

methods.name: GetUnknownGeneratedInputs
methods.description: Returns unknown generated inputs excluding those that are written files.

methods.name: ClearUnknownGeneratedInputsAndWrittenFiles
methods.description: Clears recorded unknown inputs and written files.

methods.name: IncrementWorkCount
methods.description: Increments the count of ongoing work units.

methods.name: DecrementWorkCount
methods.description: Decrements the work count and triggers completion if zero.

methods.name: SuppressOutputForTesting
methods.description: Controls output suppression for testing purposes.

methods.name: LogOnMainThread
methods.description: Outputs a log message on the main thread.

methods.name: FailWithErrorOnMainThread
methods.description: Handles error reporting on the main thread.

methods.name: OnComplete
methods.description: Handles scheduler completion, posts quit to message loop.

methods.name: WaitForPoolTasks
methods.description: Waits for all worker pool tasks to complete.
